concepts.def: Sunni: Shahadah (declaration), Salah (prayer), Zakah (charity), Sawm (fasting), Hajj (pilgrimage).
Shia framework including Five Pillars plus jihad, amr-bil-maroof (do good), tawalla, tabarra, khums.
Five daily prayers facing Mecca: Fajr (dawn), Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha; preceded by wudu (ablution).
Fasting from dawn to sunset throughout ninth month; no food, drink, smoking, sex; broken at iftar.
Pilgrimage to Mecca in Dhul-Hijjah; obligatory once if able; 2 million pilgrims annually circumambulate Kaaba.
Annual charity of 2.5% of accumulated wealth above nisab threshold; purifies remaining wealth; one of Five Pillars.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Islam: Practices — a core area of GCSE Religious Studies.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Islam: Practices brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Islam: Practices.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
